text: Death got fired. Replaced by an AI. Nobody has died since. After nine thousand years on the job, Death was called into HR. His replacement: DeathGPT. Faster, cheaper, and it never sleeps. On day one, it had a bug. It cancelled everyone's death. Heaven went quiet. Hell went bankrupt. A two hundred year old man asked for a refund. So they rehired Death. As a consultant. Double the pay. Would you trust an AI with your death?
